title: Home feed rows for a streaming service
name: Home feed builder

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the components of this feed code share data with one another? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
`HomeFeedService` receives its rows and the `Ranker` through its constructor, and rows only call `ranker.rank(...)` and the catalog's `titles_for_region`. What does that structure allow?
choices: Replacing the ranking strategy or adding a new row type without editing HomeFeedService or the other rows
Skipping the catalog cache for rows that use a ranker
Running all rows concurrently without any locking
Guaranteeing that the feed makes only one request to the title source

questions.prompt: A viewer's profile has `watched_ids` containing three titles. `AffinityRanker.rank` is called with a regional list of 500 titles. What does the caller get back?
choices: The same 500 titles, sorted by score
The 497 unwatched titles, sorted by score from highest to lowest
Only the titles whose genres match the viewer's history, sorted by score
The 497 unwatched titles in catalog order, since the returned list is built before sorting

questions.prompt: `TitleCatalog.titles_for_region` is called with the same region by the Recommended and New releases rows of one feed, 100 ms apart, with a 300 s TTL. How many times is the `TitleSource` queried, assuming the cache was empty?
choices: Never, because the source is only used by `invalidate`
Once per call to `build`, regardless of the rows
Once; the second call is served from the cached list
